jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description_text:
About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders.

Why This Role Matters

As Controller, you will be responsible for all accounting and financial operations activities for Pacific Fusion. You will work to build and optimize processes and enable the engineers and scientists across the organization as they bring our demonstration system online.

jobs.description_text:
Parallel Systems is pioneering autonomous battery-electric rail vehicles designed to transform freight transportation by shifting portions of the $900 billion U.S. trucking industry onto rail. Our innovative technology offers cleaner, safer, and more efficient logistics solutions. Join our dynamic team and help shape a smarter, greener future for global freight.

Enterprise Account Executive

Parallel Systems is seeking a commercially driven, hands-on sales leader to own revenue generation and customer expansion across freight railroads, intermodal operators, and logistics partners. This is not a transactional sales role. You will operate at the intersection of freight economics, operations, and technology, positioning Parallel’s autonomous rail system to unlock new revenue, improve lane performance, and modernize how railroads compete with trucking.

You will act as a trusted commercial partner to customers, combining sales execution with a deep understanding of freight flows, lane economics, and customer value creation. This role is ideal for someone who has sold complex freight or logistics solutions, understands how shippers and brokers think about lanes, pricing, and service levels, and can translate that knowledge into durable rail partnerships.

For the past decade, we have established strong product-market fit and a profitable, efficient operating model across a suite of products, positioning Perpay as the premier financial partner for consumers with subprime credit.

With over 500,000 customers who have utilized more than $1 billion in spending power, we are at a pivotal moment. We are scaling our operations, building new offerings, and deepening our impact. We are looking for teammates eager to join us on this journey.

Our venture partners include First Round Capital and L Catterton.

Products we’ve built to make an impact:

  • Perpay Marketplace: Combines interest-free payments and modern e-commerce to reduce cost of ownership and promote healthy repayment behavior.
  • Perpay+: Leverages Marketplace repayment history to help members monitor and build credit with all 3 credit bureaus.
  • Perpay Credit Card: Expands access to the flexibility and benefits of a World Mastercard by removing common barriers like high security deposits and low approval odds.

Our team thrives on in-person collaboration, operating from our unique center-city Philadelphia office. This comfortable "home away from home" space offers river view

Title: Video & Technology Associate
Department: Research & Information
Dates: 1/11/2027 – 10/31/2027

Status: Full-Time, Seasonal
Location(s):

  • Lehigh Valley, PA
  • Reading, PA
  • Lakewood, NJ
  • Clearwater, FL

Housing will be provided by The Phillies for this role in all locations

Position Overview:

Oversee the daily video, technology, and advance scouting operations at assigned minor league affiliate. Duties will include but not be limited to filming and logging home and road games and assisting in daily instructional film/data review sessions with coaches, players, and staff. Additionally, the VTA will be responsible for maintaining and operating all baseball technology hardware and uploading data.

Responsibilities:

  • Open and oversee operations of affiliate video room daily
  • Film and accurately log all home and road games using BATS video system
  • Film and capture data for bullpens, batting practices, and workouts based on requests by Phillies coaches and staff
  • Efficiently set up, run, and troubleshoot various baseball technologies, including but not limited to bat sensors, motion capture tools, and ball flight tracking technology

About Praxent

Praxent builds software for financial services companies, the kind where the stakes are real, the regulators are watching, and the legacy systems are not going away on their own. We have spent our history on application development for banks, insurers, lenders, payments companies, and wealth platforms, and we are now building out data platforms and AI services alongside it.

 

We are one of a very small number of smaller partners in Anthropic's managed partner program, which is otherwise made up almost entirely of global systems integrators. Our founder is still here. Our people stay. Delivery is AI-first, and collaboration is not a poster on the wall.

 

We are now investing seriously in the Microsoft ecosystem, and this role is central to that.

 

The role

You will be the technical face of Praxent in the Microsoft channel for financial services. That means working with Microsoft account teams to find where we fit, sitting with FSI executives to find what is worth funding, and owning the solution and the economics that connect the two.

Our sellers and the Microsoft field open the door. You are the person who walks through it and makes what is on the other side winnable and deliverable: you sit with FSI executives and their architects, work out what is actually worth funding, and own the solution and the economics that connect the two.
